subject: engineering_mathematics
question: The value of the limit of sin(3x) / x as x tends to 0 is
explanation: Write sin(3x)/x = 3 · sin(3x)/(3x). As x → 0 the ratio sin(u)/u tends to 1 with u = 3x, so the limit is 3 × 1 = 3.

subject: engineering_mechanics_materials
question: A steel rod of diameter 20 mm carries an axial tensile load of 31.416 kN. The normal stress in the rod is
explanation: Stress = load / area. Area = (π/4) × 20² = 314.16 mm², so σ = 31 416 N / 314.16 mm² = 100 N/mm² = 100 MPa.

subject: thermo_fluids_basics
question: The gauge pressure at a depth of 10 m in still fresh water (density 1000 kg/m³, g = 9.81 m/s²) is
explanation: Hydrostatic gauge pressure p = ρ g h = 1000 × 9.81 × 10 = 98 100 Pa = 98.1 kPa.

subject: engineering_economics_safety
question: A machine costing ₹5,00,000 has a salvage value of ₹50,000 and a useful life of 9 years. Its annual depreciation by the straight-line method is (in ₹)
explanation: Straight-line depreciation = (cost − salvage value) / life = (5,00,000 − 50,000) / 9 = ₹50,000 per year.

subject: chemical_process_engineering
question: Methane (molar mass 16 kg/kmol) burns completely: CH4 + 2 O2 → CO2 + 2 H2O. How many kg of CO2 (molar mass 44 kg/kmol) are produced by burning 16 kg of methane?
explanation: 16 kg of CH4 is 1 kmol. The equation gives 1 kmol of CO2 per kmol of CH4, so 1 kmol × 44 kg/kmol = 44 kg of CO2.

subject: chemical_process_engineering
question: A first-order reaction has a rate constant k = 0.0693 min⁻¹. Its half-life is
explanation: For a first-order reaction t½ = ln 2 / k = 0.693 / 0.0693 = 10 min, independent of the initial concentration.

subject: bioprocess_biochemistry
question: In Michaelis–Menten kinetics, the Michaelis constant Km is numerically equal to the substrate concentration at which the reaction velocity is
explanation: From v = Vmax[S]/(Km + [S]), putting [S] = Km gives v = Vmax/2. A low Km therefore means high affinity: the enzyme reaches half its top speed at a low substrate concentration.

subject: bioprocess_biochemistry
question: Starting from one double-stranded DNA template, an ideal PCR (every template copied in every cycle) of 5 cycles gives how many double-stranded DNA molecules?
explanation: Each cycle doubles the number of molecules in an ideal reaction: 2^5 = 32.

subject: aerospace_flight
question: The dynamic pressure q = ½ρV² of air of density 1.2 kg/m³ flowing at 50 m/s is
explanation: q = ½ × 1.2 × 50² = 0.5 × 1.2 × 2500 = 1500 Pa. Lift and drag are both proportional to q.

subject: aerospace_flight
question: Along the gas path of a simple turbojet engine the main components appear in the order
explanation: Air is compressed first, fuel is burned in the combustor, the hot gas drives the turbine (which powers the compressor), and the remaining energy is expanded in the nozzle to produce thrust.

subject: agricultural_soil_water
question: Field capacity of a soil is the moisture content that remains when
explanation: Field capacity is the upper limit of water a soil can hold against gravity. Permanent wilting point is the lower limit available to plants; saturation is when every pore is filled.
option_a: all water has been removed by oven-drying
option_c: excess gravitational water has drained away, usually 2–3 days after thorough wetting

subject: agricultural_soil_water
question: An irrigation event applies 80 mm of water to a field, of which 60 mm is stored in the root zone. The water application efficiency is
explanation: Water application efficiency = water stored in the root zone / water applied × 100 = 60 / 80 × 100 = 75 %.

subject: mineral_metallurgy
question: On slow cooling, austenite of about 0.8 % carbon transforms at 727 °C by the eutectoid reaction into
explanation: The eutectoid reaction γ → α + Fe3C gives pearlite. Ledeburite is the eutectic product at 4.3 % C and 1147 °C; martensite and bainite form only on faster cooling.
option_b: pearlite (alternate lamellae of ferrite and cementite)

subject: mineral_metallurgy
question: Froth flotation separates minerals mainly on the basis of differences in their
explanation: Collectors make the wanted mineral hydrophobic so it attaches to air bubbles and rises in the froth. Gravity, magnetic and electrostatic separation use the other three properties.
